description: This file defines the Dashboard class within the Opencart admin extension, responsible for managing dashboard extensions, including listing, installing, and uninstalling dashboard modules via web requests.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard extension modules in the Opencart admin panel, including listing available modules, and handling installation and uninstallation processes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the dashboard extension list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the list of available and installed dashboard extensions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks user permissions for modifying dashboard extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a dashboard extension, including permissions and resource registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a dashboard extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
